text: ok so i got it to load, by navigating to another route first then coming back, but i dont see props that are placed
resolution: RESOLVED by the OOM fix chain. The 'placed props invisible' symptom was the editor OOM-crashing during render before a stable frame — the [propgone] probes proved every prop dispatches and produces geometry (CookedProp RENDER verts=N for all studio props, DataProp parts>0 for recipe props) and the burial probe showed 0 buried / 41 on-or-above ground, so nothing was actually missing or underground. Once the grass-render cap (req_1645) stopped the million-row Scene3D.Instances command that OOM'd the heap, the editor opens and props render (the compiled-world view now shows the sign, vending machine, structures). No prop-specific draw bug existed; it was the crash. Diagnostic probes ([propgone] in Prop/CookedProp/DataProp + the burial probe in IsoAuthor) remain in the tree and should be removed in cleanup.
